pass_a_gloss: What was said must be proved from Scriptures: lift holy hands by forgiving (anger expunged); forget all outside prayer in its hour (how most blessed!) — Paul 1 Tim 2:8; the praying wife restrained/modest, revering God, exiling unchaste reminders from the ruling part, adorned as befits godliness (blessed from this condition alone) — Paul 1 Tim 2:9-10. David: the saint praying has more — seasonable: the dedicated one's disposition/preparation, even if alone it aids. 'To You I lifted my eyes' (Ps 122:1 LXX) and 'my soul' (Ps 24:1 LXX): mind's eyes lifted from earthly dwelling/material impressions, peering beyond creatures, conversing with the Hearer — already greatly profited, 'unveiled face mirroring the Lord's glory... from glory to glory' (2 Cor 3:18), partaking diviner intelligible effluence ('light of Your face signed,' Ps 4:7 LXX); soul lifted, following Spirit, separated from body, becoming in it — 'To You I lifted my soul': laying aside being soul, becoming spiritual. Forgetfulness of wrongs a greatest feat; Jeremiah sums the Law in it ('Not these I commanded... but: let each not remember evil,' Jer 7 + Zech 7:10 wording); from it to prayer keeping the Savior's 'Whenever you stand praying, forgive' (Mark 11:25) — standing thus, we already possess the best.
